settings.label: Question
settings.default: Will my phone fit inside the bag?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Yes. The bag easily accommodates all modern smartphones up to the iPhone 15 Pro Max and Samsung Galaxy Ultra series, even when enclosed in a protective case, alongside a bifold wallet and keys.

settings.question: Will my phone fit inside the bag?
settings.answer: Yes. The bag easily accommodates all modern smartphones up to the iPhone 15 Pro Max and Samsung Galaxy Ultra series, even when enclosed in a protective case, alongside a bifold wallet and keys.

settings.question: Is the leather water resistant?
settings.answer: Our full-grain leather is naturally resilient to light humidity and brief rainfall. If caught in rain, simply blot gently with a dry cotton cloth and allow it to air-dry at room temperature away from heat sources.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched from our studio warehouse within 24 hours on business days. Standard delivery within the US takes 2–4 business days. Complimentary tracking is emailed upon fulfillment.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day trial period. If the bag does not suit your everyday needs, return it in original, unworn condition with its dust bag for a full refund. A prepaid return shipping label is provided.

settings.question: Can the shoulder strap length be adjusted?
settings.answer: The strap has a fixed 28 cm drop proportioned specifically to tuck securely under the arm and stay positioned on the shoulder without sliding off your coat.
